headline: Executive order creates a White House Faith and Opportunity Initiative focused on how the government works with faith-based and community groups.
what_it_does: This order sets up a White House Faith and Opportunity Initiative. Based on the title, the Initiative focuses on how the federal government works with religious and community organizations. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, offices, and duties it sets up are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The Initiative is meant to deal with how these groups work with the federal government, though the details are not given in the source material.
These groups may be affected by the Initiative's work on partnerships with the government, though the details are not given.
Agencies may be asked to work with the new White House Initiative, though the exact duties are not described in the source material.
